title: Run a 2-Trillion Parameter AI Model on Your Laptop + Free Voice Cloning & 90K AI Skills! 🤖✨
description: Welcome to this week's AI roundup, where we explore some of the most exciting innovations in artificial intelligence! First up, discover a revolutionary tool that lets you run a two-trillion parameter model right on your laptop with just 8GB of RAM—no GPU needed. Next, Kyutai introduces PocketTTS, a powerful 100-million-parameter voice model that clones your voice for free, running six times faster than real time with a simple setup process. Kyutai Search also launched Hermes Skills Hub, offering over 90,000 free community skills across 200 categories, seamlessly integrating with platforms like OpenAI, Anthropic, and NVIDIA. On the image front, XAI released Grok Imagine Image 2.0, featuring advanced editing tools such as regional point-and-change, background removal, multi-reference image use, and smart resizing. Lastly, Meta unveiled MuseCode, their first coding agent designed to run in your terminal, keep background agents active, and work safely on your repository using parallel work trees. Don’t miss out on the latest AI breakthroughs!
